sentences.en: She continued to see him in disregard of my advice.
sentences.zh: 她不顾我的劝告继续和他交往。

sentences.en: He disregards his wife every time she asks to cuddle.
sentences.zh: 每次妻子要求拥抱时，他都毫不理会。

sentences.en: I am offended by your blatant disregard for my feelings.
sentences.zh: 你公然忽视我的感受让我很受伤。

senses.zh: 不顾, 不理会, 无视
漠视, 忽视, 蔑视
